55309.meaning1: meditation in the realm of form

55311.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.9) rūpiyaṃ nāma satthuvaṇṇo kahāpaṇo, lohamāsako, dārumāsako, jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi, na c'āyam'āyasmā suvaṇṇapātiyā'pi rūpiyacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā'ti. tam'enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati, rūpiyacetāpakaṃ ṭhapetvā, sabbeh'eva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.

no ce chaḍḍeti, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, chaḍḍit'āchaḍḍitañ'ca jāneyya.

idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi, na c'āyam'āyasmā rūpiyapātiyā'pi suvaṇṇacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā'ti. tam'enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.

55319.meaning1: recipient of the money; who received the cash

examples.text: sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati rūpiyappaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeh'eva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pallaṅkasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so pallaṅko hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena paribhuñjāmi, dantamayo vā sāramayo vā sovaṇṇamayo vā rūpiyamayo vā.

55322.commentary: (VINa) rūpiye rūpiyasaññī'ti ettha sabbam'pi jātarūparajataṃ rūpiyasaṅgaham'eva gatan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: rūpiye rūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

55323.meaning1: trading in valuables; business dealing; money exchange

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

55324.meaning1: rule about trading with money; Nissaggiya 19

examples.text: saññā nu kho, bhante, purisassa attā, udāhu aññā saññā añño attā'ti? kaṃ pana tvaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attānaṃ paccesī'ti? oḷārikaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi rūpiṃ cātumahābhūtikaṃ kabaḷīkār'āhārabhakkhan'ti.
ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

55330.meaning1: attached to form; attracted to form; engaged with matter
55330.commentary: (DNa) rūp'ūpāyan'ti rūpaṃ upagataṃ hutvā. pañcavokārabhavasmiñ'hi abhisaṅkhāraviññāṇaṃ rūpakkhandhaṃ nissāya tiṭṭhati. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. (NIDD1a) rūp'ūpayan'ti taṇhādiṭṭh'ūpayavasena rūpaṃ upagantvā ārammaṇaṃ katvā.

examples.text: upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

55331.meaning1: accumulation of matter that is clung to
55331.commentary: (DNa) khandhaniddese rūpañ'ca taṃ upādānakkhandho cā'ti rūp'upādānakkhandho evaṃ sabbattha. (PMa) rūpam'eva upādānakkhandho'ti rūp'upādānakkhandho. es'eva nayo sesesu'pi.

examples.text: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
katamo c'āvuso, rūp'upādānakkhandho? cattāri ca mahābhūtāni, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.

55332.meaning1: in physical form; with material body
55332.commentary: (ITIa) rūp'ūpagā'ti rūpabhav'ūpagā. rūpabhavo hi idha rūpan'ti vutto, rūp'ūpapattiyā maggaṃ bhāvetī'ti-ādīsu viya. (SNPa) ekādasavidhāya kāmadhātuyā sattā rūp'ūpagā kabaḷīkār'āhārasevanato.

examples.text: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.

tasmiṃ y'eva gaṅgākūle ṭhitā bandhumatī nāma gaṇikā assosi raññā kira evaṃ vuttaṃ sakkā nu kho imaṃ mahāgaṅgaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpetun'ti, sā evam'āha ahañ'hi nagare pāṭaliputte gaṇikā rūp'ūpajīvinī antimajīvikā, mama tāva rājā saccakiriyaṃ passatū'ti.

55334.meaning1: providing a sight; arranging something to see

examples.text: rūp'ūpahāro nāma amanāpikaṃ rūpaṃ upasaṃharati bhayānakaṃ bheravaṃ, imaṃ passitvā uttasitvā marissatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. taṃ passitvā uttasati, āpatti thull'accayassa.

55335.meaning1: accumulation of matter that is clung to

examples.text: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

55336.meaning1: attached to form; attracted to form; engaged with matter
55336.commentary: (DNa) rūp'ūpāyan'ti rūpaṃ upagataṃ hutvā. pañcavokārabhavasmiñ'hi abhisaṅkhāraviññāṇaṃ rūpakkhandhaṃ nissāya tiṭṭhati. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. (NIDD1a) rūp'ūpayan'ti taṇhādiṭṭh'ūpayavasena rūpaṃ upagantvā ārammaṇaṃ katvā.

examples.text: catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. rūp'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati

55337.synonym: parivaḍḍhati, pavaḍḍhati, phātikaroti, brūheti, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhayati, vaddhati

examples.text: akaronto'pi ce pāpaṃ, karontam'upasevati, saṅkiyo hoti pāpasmiṃ, avaṇṇo c'assa rūhati.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

55338.meaning1: (of a speech) is accepted; stands (in court)
55338.commentary: (DNa) sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhatī'ti vinicchayaṭṭhāne sakkhipuṭṭhassa sato vacanaṃ na rūhati, na patiṭṭhāti, ayaṃ akkhasoṇḍo jūtakaro, mā tassa vacanaṃ gaṇhitthā'ti vattāro bhavanti.

examples.text: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoge. jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jino vittam'anusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāhavivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti, akkhadhutto ayaṃ purisapuggalo n'ālaṃ dārabharaṇāyā'ti.
andhakamakasā na vijjare, kacche rūḷhatiṇe caranti gāvo, vuṭṭhim'pi saheyyum'āgataṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
andhakamakasā na vijjare, kacche rūḷhatiṇe caranti gāvo, vuṭṭhim'pi saheyyum'āgataṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

ajja't'agge te, āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa na c'eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo, yam'pi c'aññe samaṇ'uddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sā'pi te n'atthi, cara'pi re, vinassā'ti.
aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitakā, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutakā, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjakā
atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussāretvā majjhe reṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkameyyan'ti.

55347.meaning1: name of a king; son of king Disampati
55347.meaning2: name of one the seven Bharata kings

examples.text: disampatissa rañño govindo nāma brāhmaṇo purohito ahosi. disampatissa rañño reṇu nāma kumāro putto ahosi. govindassa brāhmaṇassa jotipālo nāma māṇavo putto ahosi.

55349.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; Sāriputta's younger brother; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in forest dwelling; Revata Khadiravaniya
55349.commentary: (ANa) revato khadiravaniyo'ti dhammasenāpatittherassa kaniṭṭhabhātiko. so yathā aññe therā araññe vasamānā vanasabhāgaṃ udakasabhāgaṃ bhikkhācārasabhāgañ'ca sallakkhetvā araññe vasanti, na evaṃ vasi. etāni pana sabhāgāni anādiyitvā ujjaṅgalasakkharapāsāṇavisame khadiravane paṭivasati. tasmā āraññakānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.

examples.text: āyasmatā ca mahācundena āyasmatā ca anuruddhena āyasmatā ca revatena āyasmatā ca ānandena, aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraññakānaṃ yadidaṃ revato khadiravaniyo.

55352.synonym: aṭṭi, ātaṅka, ābādha, āmaya, gada, gilānabhāva, byādhi, vyādhi

examples.text: yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhan'āgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantār'addhānamaggaṃ
yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñātirogabhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.

55354.meaning1: type of disease; kind of illness

examples.text: eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇḍakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho. so yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati. yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati.

55355.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of roga

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

ye'pi hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato dakkhissanti dukkhato dakkhissanti anattato dakkhissanti rogato dakkhissanti bhayato dakkhissanti, te taṇhaṃ pajahissanti.

55357.meaning1: abode of disease; nest of illness

examples.text: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.
jātaṃ bhūtaṃ samuppannaṃ, kataṃ saṅkhatam'addhuvaṃ, jarāmaraṇasaṅghāṭaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na iti paṭisañcikkhati, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho
ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa

55359.meaning1: because of loss of health; due to illness

examples.text: pañca byasanāni, ñātibyasanaṃ, bhogabyasanaṃ, rogabyasanaṃ, sīlabyasanaṃ, diṭṭhibyasanaṃ. n'āvuso, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

55360.meaning1: like a disease; like an illness

examples.text: ayaṃ kho pana, māgaṇḍiya, kāyo rogabhūto gaṇḍabhūto sallabhūto aghabhūto ābādhabhūto, so tvaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ rogabhūtaṃ gaṇḍabhūtaṃ sallabhūtaṃ aghabhūtaṃ ābādhabhūtaṃ, idan'taṃ, bho gotama, ārogyaṃ, idan'taṃ nibbānan'ti vadesi.

55364.meaning1: strong disease; serious illness; powerful sickness

examples.text: tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati. tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, piyā vata maṃ kāmā jahissanti, piye c'āhaṃ kāme jahissāmī'ti.
puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

55366.meaning1: suffering from; ill with; having a certain disease

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya paṇḍukarogī.

55369.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd sg of rocati, intrans

examples.text: kattari ca attanopadāni honti. maññate, rocate, socate, bujjhate, jāyate.

55371.meaning1: approves (of); agrees (with); finds pleasing; (comm) wishes for

examples.text: jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti, jāto dukkhāni phussati, bandhaṃ vadhaṃ pariklesaṃ, tasmā jātiṃ na rocaye.
na gaṇena purakkhato care, vimano hoti samādhi dullabho, nānājanasaṅgaho dukho, iti disvāna gaṇaṃ na rocaye.
kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati, kissa'ssu ekadhammassa, vadhaṃ rocesi gotamā'ti.
brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchābhūmakā kamaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā aggiparicārikā udak'orohakā soceyyāni paññapenti, tes'āhaṃ soceyyāni rocemī'ti

55375.meaning2: having given one's consent, having liked

55376.commentary: (THIa) na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍe'ti tāpasaparibbājak'ādīnaṃ ādāsabhūte pāsaṇḍe te te samay'antare n'eva rocesi.

examples.text: kaṃ nu uddissa muṇḍ'āsi, samaṇī viya dissasi, na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍe, kim'idaṃ carasi momuhā.
kiṃ nu jātiṃ na rocesi, jāto kāmāni bhuñjati, bhuñjāhi kāmaratiyo, m'āhu pacch'ānutāpinī.

55377.meaning1: name of a group of deities
55377.commentary: (DNa) ariṭṭhakā ca rojā cā'ti ariṭṭhakadevā ca rojadevā ca.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā, jalam'aggisikhā'r'iva, ariṭṭhakā ca rojā ca, umāpupphanibhāsino.
n'āhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evam'āha, api ca me idaṃ, bhante, kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
sv'āhaṃ abbūḷhasallo'smi, sītibhūto'smi nibbuto, na socāmi na rodāmi, vata sutvāna māṇavāti.

55379.commentary: (JAa) naccenā'ti etehi nacc'ādīhi nimittaṃ karoti. tattha roditena nimittakaraṇena rattiṃ deve vassante vātapānena hatthiṃ āropetvā seṭṭhiputtena nītāya purohitabrāhmaṇiyā vatthu kathetabbaṃ.

examples.text: cattālīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati… dadāti, yācati, katam'anukaroti, uccaṃ bhāsati, nīcaṃ bhāsati, aviccaṃ bhāsati, viviccaṃ bhāsati, naccena gītena vāditena rodanena vilasitena vibhūsitena jagghati, pekkhati, kaṭiṃ cāleti, guyhabhaṇḍakaṃ sañcāleti, ūruṃ vivarati…
na taṃ kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu, yaṃ katvā anutappati, yassa assumukho rodaṃ, vipākaṃ paṭisevati.
api ca kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuṭṭaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā

so osānakalāpe ayasalākāya kirī'ti saddaṃ sutvā, kiṃ etan'ti pucchitvā sabbakalāpesu ayasalākānaṃ ṭhapitabhāvaṃ ñatvā asiṃ chaḍḍetvā rodamāno mayhaṃ ettakesu ñātisuhajjesu eko'pi sasineho hutvā imaṃ kāraṇaṃ n'ācikkhi.
rudimha cā'ti puna vippaṭisārino evarūpaṃ nāma amhehi katan'ti rodimha ca.

55386.commentary: (JAa) roditaṃ mogham'āhu santo'ti, buddh'ādayo pana paṇḍitā roditaṃ moghan'ti vadanti.

examples.text: daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati, aññatra roditamattā!
mataṃ marissaṃ rodanti, ye rudanti lapanti ca, tasmā tvaṃ isi mā rodi, roditaṃ mogham'āhu santo.

55387.meaning1: mere crying; a bit of wailing
55387.commentary: (MNa) roditamattā'ti jighacchāpipāsāparetassa pana roditamattaṃ hoti. tam'pi kilesasahagatacitten'eva.

examples.text: daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati, aññatra roditamattā!
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti, rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha rodhataṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.
ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.

55397.meaningLit: for the sake of causing to grow

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso vaṇaṃ ālimpeyya yāva'd'eva ropan'atthāya, seyyathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāva'd'eva bhārassa nittharaṇ'atthāya
